comments: Great location, two blocks from the beach. The place was spotless and check-in was easy.
The air conditioning stopped working on the second night and it took a day to get someone to fix it.
Very noisy at night. Loud music from the neighbors until 2am and nobody answered when we called.
Nice view and comfortable beds. A bit dusty in the bathroom but nothing major.
We could not find the lockbox and waited an hour outside with our luggage. Instructions were confusing.
Perfect for our family. The pool was clean and the kids loved it. Would book again.
The apartment smelled like smoke and the sheets were stained. We asked for a refund.
Overpriced for what you get. Small kitchen and very few towels.
Host was super responsive and gave great tips for restaurants. Everything worked as described.
Parking was a nightmare, the building only has two spots for all guests.
Wifi kept dropping so I could not work. Otherwise a pleasant stay.
Spotless, modern, and exactly like the photos. Highly recommend.
